text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — metering service: high token-count drift (tokens_emitted > expected by 42% over 5m). Auto-alerting threshold hit. Triggering oncall.
maria_oncall: I’m on it. Starting an initial blast radius check — which customers saw spike?

sam_plat: early look shows a high fanout from emitter-v2 in us-west-2. Traffic pattern shifted to many tiny requests, batching dropped.

anita_finance: do we have any customer-visible billing alerts raised yet? CFO team pinged about possible overages.

ryan_ml: log tail from emitter (last 60s):
```
2026-03-18T14:05:12Z emitter-v2 INFO emitted=1200 batch_size=1 route=client-xy
2026-03-18T14:05:13Z emitter-v2 INFO emitted=1300 batch_size=1 route=client-ab
2026-03-18T14:05:20Z emitter-v2 WARN batching_disabled=true reason=kv-cache-miss
```
Looks like KV cache invalidations plus a bad batching config after the 14:00 deploy.

maria_oncall: rolling back batching config on the active pool to previous working value, running: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/reconfig -d '{"batching":true,"max_batch":64}'`

deploy-bot: Reconfig request accepted. Applying to pool: metering-prod-pool-7 (us-west-2). Request id: req_76a9

jess_sre: Oncall note — if we can't restore batching within 5m, toggle emitter to rate-limit clients flagged as high-frequency to avoid over-counts. Command to soft-block: `rbacctl update emit_policy --rate-limit 10/s --tag highfreq`

maria_oncall: update applied, observed immediate change in emit pattern:
```
2026-03-18T14:07:01Z emitter-v2 INFO emitted=320 batch_size=40
2026-03-18T14:07:02Z emitter-v2 INFO emitted=300 batch_size=38
```
Counts trending back towards baseline.

anita_finance: are overage flags cleared automatically? Do we need to notify customers?

sam_plat: internal shadow counts still show a ~6% delta vs pre-incident baseline; customer-facing billing flags require manual scrub. Recommend holding customer alerts until we validate a full reconciliation run.

ryan_ml: running a quick reconcile job (dry-run) against the ledger for the last 90m to estimate exposed accounts. Cmd: `python tools/reconcile.py --start -90m --dry-run --filter emit_source=emitter-v2`

jess_sre: FYI we saw one failing config rollout that bumped `batching_disabled` on new nodes. Tracking to edge case in rollout script. Opening a PR to add a preflight: https://git.redwood/rollouts/pull/412

maria_oncall: timeline so far: pager 14:05 -> rate-limit 14:06 -> batching restored 14:07 -> reconcile started 14:08. Current status: mitigated, recon in progress.

anita_finance: thanks — if reconcile shows customer-exposed deltas > $1000 for any account, we should trigger billing ops + CS notification template B. Otherwise we do a silent credit sweep.

incident-bot: Incident status updated to: mitigated (partial). Severity: sev3 -> monitoring. Follow-up: postmortem needed, include rollout preflight and batching guard.

maria_oncall: assigning follow-up owners: @sam_plat to lead root-cause, @jess_sre to add rollout preflight, @ryan_ml to validate reconcile results. I’ll keep the postmortem skeleton.

sam_plat: quick note — if anyone needs the raw metric series: graphite path `metering.emitter.v2.tokens_emitted.us-west-2.1m`. Use window [14:00-14:10] for the spike.

ryan_ml: reconcile dry-run complete: 12 accounts show >0 delta, 2 accounts exceed $1200 projected. Attaching short list (sanitized) — will open billing tickets and draft customer comms.

anita_finance: please cc billing-ops and CS on those tickets. I’ll prepare credit authorization if needed.

jess_sre: postmortem checklist: include detection tuning (reduce false positives), add batching health alarm, and enforce config rollout canary for 1 hour.

maria_oncall: closing thread for now — monitoring for stability. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
